capability.summary: Query recent USGS earthquakes as GeoJSON
capability.description: Queries the USGS FDSN event endpoint for GeoJSON earthquakes, fixing limit=5 and exposing only the optional minimum magnitude argument through the wrapper. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Recent earthquake-event discovery and magnitude filtering; not seismic hazard prediction, geocoding, or emergency advice.

constraint.io_signature: Input: no user-bindable CLI parameters; output: JSON envelope containing http_status and fixed USGS GeoJSON or HTTP error body; wrapper internally sends minmagnitude=4, limit=5, and format=geojson. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: no user-bindable input; minmagnitude=4, limit=5, and format=geojson are fixed by the wrapper
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://earthquake.usgs.gov/fdsnws/event/1/query; wrapper reads no valid user parameter and always sends minmagnitude=4, limit=5, and format=geojson
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
starttime and minmagnitude are not accepted manifest inputs; no caller-controlled limit, pagination, or additional filters
API result is capped at five events and wrapper performs no additional parsing or truncation
no auth, cache, or retry; live seismic feed and external network make results non-deterministic

output_contract.description: JSON envelope containing up to five USGS earthquake GeoJSON features, URL, and HTTP status.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

negative_intents: predict future earthquakes or seismic risk
provide emergency response or geocoding data
